# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE severity
df_severe = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999.0) in the baseline biomarker
sentinel_values = df_severe[df_severe['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients, excluding sentinel values
mean_biomarker_severe = df_severe[df_severe['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_biomarker_severe"}
